environment.database: remote Supabase test project, confirmed test environment; no migrations applied
environment.mercado_pago: test seller context from prior sanitized environment verification; test identity indicated; checkout target was sandbox host

scenarios.name: Register synthetic account through UI
scenarios.result: POST /api/auth/register returned HTTP 201 in 6.65 s. Response keys were user, organization and expiresIn. Account identifier masked; document values and credentials omitted.

scenarios.name: Login through UI with the synthetic account
scenarios.result: POST /api/auth/login returned HTTP 200 in 1.54 s on first login and 1.47 s on the checkout run. Auth profile/access requests returned HTTP 200.

scenarios.name: Load service catalog and price
scenarios.result: GET /api/checkout/catalog-prices returned HTTP 200. The selected card and detail modal both displayed R$ 250,00 for Diagnóstico Autodeclarável / Pré-Diagnóstico ESG Autodeclarável.

scenarios.name: Create preference by selecting service card and confirming purchase
scenarios.result: After selecting the service card and clicking Comprar Agora in its detail modal, POST /api/checkout/preference carried productCode PRE_DIAGNOSTIC and quantity 1. HTTP 201 arrived in 3.68 s. The browser then navigated to the sandbox Mercado Pago redirect. No HTTP 400 occurred in this valid selected-service flow.

scenarios.name: Open provider sandbox checkout
scenarios.result: Browser navigated to https://sandbox.mercadopago.com.br/checkout/v1/redirect (query string redacted). The provider GET returned HTTP 403 in 184 ms with text/html and an error page in Spanish. No payment form was submitted.

scenarios.name: Investigate HTTP 400 on valid checkout flow
scenarios.result: No 400 was returned by the valid UI flow; preference creation returned 201. The provider navigation failed with 403 instead. Code inspection of checkoutController.ts shows invalid Zod input and any caught service exception are mapped to 400, so a future 400 needs its sanitized response message and backend log to identify the cause. No invalid or unselected product request was sent.

observations: The first card-level Comprar action opens the service detail modal; it does not create a checkout until Comprar Agora is clicked.
The app showed a transient profile loading view immediately after registration; login in a fresh browser context succeeded and loaded the catalog.

The browser captured preference status and timing, but could not read the preference response JSON before navigation. Backend code defines the response fields as checkoutUrl, orderId, productCode and totalCents; identifiers and the URL query string are excluded from this report.
The valid checkout created a pending application order/preference in the test environment. No payment was submitted.

synthetic_accounts.result: Registration and login succeeded; synthetic data only.

limitations: HTTP 400 was not reproduced in the valid purchase path, so no 400 response body is available.
Mercado Pago sandbox returned 403 before a payment form could be used.
The preference JSON was interrupted/unavailable to the browser response listener during redirect; only HTTP status, duration, product code, quantity and sandbox navigation were captured.
next_actions: Investigate Mercado Pago sandbox 403 using the same verified test seller and an approved test buyer; do not submit payment until the sandbox page loads.
If a 400 is still observed, capture the response message and correlated sanitized backend error for that specific request; this run did not produce one.
Do not apply migrations as part of this QA report.
